title: Chapter Schema
description: Standardized data model for a chapter in Athena OS.

prose_content.description: Complete chapter prose, not a summary.

id.description: Unique identifier for the chapter (e.g., CHAP-01)

title.description: The title or primary focus of the chapter

objective.description: The narrative structural goal (e.g., Inciting Incident, Establish B-Story)

summary.description: A concise summary of the events that occur

cliffhanger.description: The specific unanswered question, revelation, or tension hook at the end of the chapter

continuity_notes.description: Specific facts established in this chapter that must remain true globally (e.g., character injury, lost item)
